prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: realistic open book cutout for an animated website decoration. One beautiful real small hardcover book opened at the middle, perfectly centered, completely isolated on a genuinely transparent background. Warm ivory blank uncoated paper with fine visible fibers, layered page edges and gently curved open pages, a muted lavender woven linen hardcover visible as a very thin rim beneath the pages, realistic sewn binding and central gutter. Photograph directly from above with just a tiny low frontal angle so the thickness of the pages can be seen. The central spine must be straight and vertical, exactly at the horizontal center; do not rotate the book diagonally. Both open page halves should be similarly sized, almost rectangular and clearly defined, with a gentle realistic concave curvature towards the central gutter. Entire book comfortably in frame with generous transparent margin. Premium editorial product photography, natural diffused window light from upper left, detailed paper and cloth material, soft natural contact shadow directly underneath the book only. No long cast shadow, no glow or halo, no table, no hands, no bookmark, no other objects, no writing, no logos, no illustrations, no checkerboard graphic, no text. Wide landscape composition, photoreal rather than icon/vector/cartoon or shiny plastic CGI. This is the stationary base of an animation; keep the shape and central binding clean and symmetrical.
